name: puzzle
description: Read and manage a company's books in Puzzle: transactions, categorization, bills, invoices, reconciliation, reports and runway.

interface.longDescription:
Puzzle keeps a startup's double-entry books from its bank, card, payroll and payment data. Connect your Puzzle account to ask about cash, burn and runway, pull a balance sheet or income statement, review and categorize transactions, work through bills and invoices, and reconcile accounts.

The connection is read-only until you turn on write access, and every change to the books is confirmed with you before it is made. You choose which companies the connection can see when you sign in, and you can revoke it any time in Puzzle under Settings → Connected apps.
capabilities: Financial reports: balance sheet, income statement, cash flow
Bills, AP aging and vendor spend
Invoices, AR aging and customer payments
defaultPrompt: What's our runway, and how has monthly burn changed this quarter?
Show last month's income statement and explain the biggest changes.
Which transactions still need a category?
